## Repository layout

```text
lucid-writer/
├── skills/lucid-writer/        # the skill: SKILL.md, references/, assets/, scripts/
├── agents/                     # Claude Code review subagents (lucid-*.md)
├── .codex/agents/              # Codex twins of the subagents (lucid_*.toml)
├── network/conventions/lucid-writer/   # Mycelium convention pack
├── .claude-plugin/             # plugin.json, marketplace.json
├── .codex-plugin/plugin.json
├── plugin.json                 # portable manifest
├── pyproject.toml, lucid_writer/       # packaging shim for acumen
├── bench/                      # acumen benchmark
├── evals/                      # cases, rubric, case studies
├── docs/                       # architecture, methodology, subagents
├── site/                       # this website
└── scripts/                    # installers, validate_repo.py
```

## Validation

```bash
python3 scripts/validate_repo.py
```

This checks, among other things:

- the skill's frontmatter, reference files and assets;
- that both sets of subagents exist, are read-only, and that each Codex twin keeps the key rules of its Markdown source;
- that `lucid_writer.__version__`, the three plugin manifests and the convention pack carry one version;
- that every bench skill snapshot matches `skill_name` in `bench/config.yaml`;
- that every repository link on this site points at a file that exists.

CI runs it with the linter self-test, the ledger check, a wheel build and `acumen check --no-review`.

## Packaging

`pyproject.toml` and `lucid_writer/__init__.py` exist only so acumen can target the repository: it refuses a checkout with no installable Python package, then requires the package to import. Neither is part of the skill. `lucid_writer.__version__` is the single source of the version number.

## Benchmark workflow

Edit `skills/lucid-writer/`, re-copy it to `bench/skills/v1`, commit, then run acumen from `bench/`. Acumen benchmarks the committed `main`, not the working tree. The commands and caveats are in [`bench/README.md`](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-writer/blob/main/bench/README.md).

## Contributing

Changes should fix a demonstrated failure rather than add prompt text. Add or update an eval case for every material behaviour change. See [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-writer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Security

Audit any fork before installing executable skills. The bundled helpers use only the Python standard library, make no network requests, and write project files only when `init_project.py` runs. See [`SECURITY.md`](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-writer/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

## Design provenance

lucid-writer is an original synthesis. Sources and licences are in [`docs/methodology.md`](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-writer/blob/main/docs/methodology.md) and [`NOTICE.md`](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-writer/blob/main/NOTICE.md); ideas adapted from scriptorium are re-expressed in original wording.

## This site

The site is hand-written Quarto in `site/`. Preview it with:

```bash
quarto preview site
```

Pushing to `main` with changes under `site/` renders it and deploys it to GitHub Pages through `.github/workflows/docs.yml`. Pages must be enabled once: in the repository's **Settings → Pages**, set **Source** to **GitHub Actions**.
